mapper.insert: insert into daily_statistics(user_email, stat_date, keyboard_count, mouse_click_count, mouse_distance) values (#{user_email}, #{stat_date}, #{keyboard_count}, #{mouse_click_count}, #{mouse_distance}) as new on duplicate key update keyboard_count = new.keyboard_count, mouse_click_count = new.mouse_click_count, mouse_distance = new.mouse_distance

insert into app_usage_records(user_email, stat_date, app_name, total_duration, sessions, last_window_title) values (#{user_email}, #{stat_date}, #{app_name}, #{total_duration}, #{sessions}, #{last_window_title})
mapper.update: update app_usage_records set total_duration = #{total_duration}, sessions = sessions + #{add_sessions}, last_window_title = case when #{last_window_title} is null then last_window_title else #{last_window_title} end, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into app_window_titles(record_id, window_title) values (#{record_id}, #{window_title})
insert ignore into data_date_index(user_email, stat_date) values (#{user_email}, #{stat_date})
mapper.delete: delete t from app_window_titles t inner join app_usage_records r on t.record_id = r.id where r.user_email = #{user_email}
